questions.question: Who threatened to kill Elijah, causing him to flee?
How did God reveal himself to Elijah at Horeb?
options: In an earthquake that shook the cave
In a fire that swept across the whole mountain
In a still small voice (a gentle whisper)
In a roaring wind that split the rocks
questions.answer: In a still small voice (a gentle whisper)

questions.question: God told Elijah to anoint Elisha as prophet in his place.
